newsitem.title: SPAIN: Chilean 1997 growth to be 5.5 to 6.0 pct - Aninat.
newsitem.headline: Chilean 1997 growth to be 5.5 to 6.0 pct - Aninat.

text.p: Finance Minister Eduardo Aninat reiterated on Monday that Chilean growth would slow to 5.5 to six percent this year from seven percent in 1996.

"The perspectives for 1997 are for a slight moderation in growth to reach GDP of between 5.5 percent and six percent," Aninat said in a speech at the annual meeting of the Inter-American Development Bank.
This is the government's growth forecast for 1997.
But despite the moderation, growth would be superior to that in similar phases of previous cycles. In 1994, for example, growth was 4.3 percent, while in 1990 it was 3.3, Aninat said.
"We are managing an economic cycle of notable growth and of pronounced stability," he said. --Sharman Esarey, IADB Newsroom +34 3 424 2659
